scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx prisma db seed && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.prisma:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd backend && npx eslint src --ext .ts && cd ../frontend && npx next lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
